At maximum 255 characters are interpreted. len App Description The length of the description for the Application Id string (number of characters of description string). context Description Points to description string for the provided context. At maximum 255 characters are interpreted. len Context Description The length of the description string (number of characters of description string). Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: The required operation succeeded. DLT_ E_ CONTEXT_ ALREADY_ REG: The software module context has already registered. DLT_ E_ UNKNOWN_ SESSION_ ID: The provided session id is unk nown. Description The service has to be called when a software module wants to use services offered by DLT software component for a specific context. If a Context Id is being registered for an already registered Application Id then app Description can be NULL and len_ app D escription zero. Available via Dlt.h
